name: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo America Inc
old_description: TOK’s state-of-the-art micro processing technology produces groundbreaking and innovative products.
about:
Tokyo Ohka Kogyo America Inc. (TOK America) operates from Hillsboro, Oregon, as the U.S. supply hub for its Japanese parent, Tokyo Ohka Kogyo Co., Ltd., a global leader in advanced chemical formulations. The subsidiary was established to serve semiconductor manufacturers in the United States and Europe with photoresists and high-purity chemical agents.

The company manufactures both positive and negative photoresists, including g-line and advanced immersion formulations capable of forming features at the tens-of-nanometers scale. Its Hillsboro campus comprises several buildings where it produces a wide variety of liquid and powder chemistries. Beyond its own product lines, TOK America provides toll manufacturing, scaling from pilot batches to full commercial volumes, and supports customers with laboratory research, process development, equipment reconfiguration, and a full suite of inspection and analytical services. The inspection laboratory houses instruments such as ICP-MS, ICP-OES, gas and ion chromatographs, a Hitachi SEM, and a Nikon stepper.

Primary customers are semiconductor device makers and packaging houses in the U.S. and Europe, along with medical-device manufacturers. The firm also supplies auxiliary chemicals for semiconductor processing. All projects are conducted under confidentiality agreements, and the company emphasizes its 20-year U.S. manufacturing track record and strict health-and-safety programs for handling hazardous reagents.

TOK America differentiates itself through its ISO 14001-certified environmental management system (registered in 2004), its ability to handle highly corrosive, reactive, and carcinogenic materials safely, and its integrated service model that combines product engineering, packaging, labeling, warehousing, and logistics under one roof.

name: Tomlin Lighting, Inc.
about:
Tomlin Lighting, Inc. was founded in 1982 in Long Island, New York. The company began with a commitment to expert personal service at a competitive price.

The company manufactures lighting and LED fixtures and operates a retail and service location offering lamp parts, shades, bulbs, and lighting repairs and refinishing. It also provides custom made-to-order products under its own Tomlin Lighting brand. The facility serves customers both at its Long Island showroom and through its website across the East Coast.

Tomlin Lighting serves residential and commercial customers throughout the East Coast, with tens of thousands served at its Long Island location since 1982 and thousands more monthly via online sales. Its customer base includes homeowners, contractors, and designers seeking lighting fixtures, repair services, and custom solutions.

The company emphasizes its dual role as manufacturer and service provider, stating that its manufacturing background brings a wider range of knowledge to help customers select lighting they will enjoy for years. This combination of production expertise and personal service is cited as its core differentiator.

about:
Toner Electric Company has served Newport County from Middletown, Rhode Island, since 1952. Richard Toner founded the business in Newport, initially performing residential and commercial installations that included work for the Newport Naval Base. His nephew Frank Toner Sr. took over in 1978, incorporated the company, and moved it to in 1987 as his sons Frank Jr. and Scott entered the trade. Today the third generation — Frank Toner Jr. as president and Scott Toner as vice president — runs the family-owned and operated contractor with a fourth-generation apprentice already on the crew.

The company operates as a full-service electrical contractor handling residential and commercial work of any scale, from a single outlet to complete commercial fire alarm systems. Services include wiring, service upgrades, panel replacements, renovations, troubleshooting, repairs, EV charger installations (Level 2 for all makes including Tesla wall mounts), and commercial fire alarm design, installation, code upgrades, radio box replacement, and quarterly or semi-annual inspections. A bucket truck and fully stocked service vans support field work, and the team of licensed journeyman electricians covers both residential and commercial specialties.

Customers span homeowners, businesses, and municipal accounts across Aquidneck Island and surrounding towns. The company has historically performed work for the U.S. Navy at the Newport Naval Base and continues to serve commercial property managers, retail and office tenants, and residential clients needing upgrades, renovations, or new construction wiring. Fire alarm contracts include code-compliant installations and recurring inspections for commercial facilities.

Toner Electric emphasizes direct owner contact — calls are answered by Frank Jr. or Scott, not a dispatch center — and a "no job too small" philosophy. The firm highlights neat, clean work habits, first-visit completion enabled by well-stocked vans, and continuity provided by multi-generational family ownership and long-tenured journeymen.

name: Tonkin Parts Center
old_description: Great place to get OEM parts. Well managed. We have been doing business with them since 2007. Our partnership help our business to grow.
about:
Tonkin Parts Center operates from Portland, Oregon, where it was established in 2007. The business functions as a wholesale auto parts warehouse serving both local and national markets from its Pacific Northwest location. Ownership details are not disclosed in public sources.

The company stocks and distributes original equipment manufacturer (OEM) parts across collision, mechanical, and glass categories. Its inventory covers body kits, doors, roofs, bumpers, fenders, quarter panels, intake and suspension components, ignition, brake and fuel delivery parts, as well as windshields, side windows, rearview mirrors, and sunroofs. The warehouse offers local delivery throughout the Portland area and ships nationally.

Customers include independent repair shops, collision centers, and dealerships that need OEM components for brands such as Acura, Alfa Romeo, Audi, Cadillac, Chevrolet, Chrysler, Dodge, Fiat, Ford, GMC, Genesis, Honda, Hyundai, Hummer, Jeep, Kia, Mopar, Mazda, Lincoln, Mercury, Nissan, Porsche, RAM, Scion, Subaru, and Toyota. One long-term account, Alpha Motors, has sourced parts from the warehouse since its opening year.

Tonkin Parts Center emphasizes breadth of brand coverage under one roof and the ability to deliver coast to coast, positioning itself as the largest OEM wholesale auto parts warehouse in the western United States.

old_description: Top Notch Sheet Metal is excited to announce the addition of an
about:
Top Notch Sheet Metal, a family-owned custom sheet metal fabrication shop, was established in 2005 in Covington, Kentucky. The business began with a team of experienced metal craftsmen bringing over a century of combined experience in sheet metal fabrication, custom stainless steel work, design, and installation.

The company provides a broad range of metalworking services including laser cutting and etching, CNC plasma cutting, CNC water jet cutting (with a five-axis OMAX MAXIEM Water Jet), welding, forming, rolling, stamping, and shearing and bending up to 12 feet. It produces commercial and residential kitchen hoods, HVAC ventilation and air handling solutions, glazing products, roof curbs and flashing, door frames, hoppers, chutes, machine guards, window guards, and Lexan protective shielding. The shop works with aluminum, copper, galvanized steel, stainless steel, brass, hot and cold rolled steel, as well as composites, glass, and plastics.

Top Notch serves the food processing and kitchen equipment industries, HVAC and ducting contractors, foundries, iron works, glazing contractors, marine fabricators, and roofing specialists. Its custom stainless steel kitchens, machine guards, and architectural metalwork are installed in commercial, industrial, and residential projects throughout the region.

The company emphasizes guaranteed high-quality customer service as its primary differentiator, building lasting relationships that drive repeat business and referrals. The recent addition of the OMAX MAXIEM Water Jet expanded its capability to cut, bevel, chamfer, and etch a wider variety of materials and thicknesses, further supporting its customer-focused approach.

The company supplies home healthcare equipment and supplies while providing a suite of support services. THS serves patients requiring home medical equipment, referring physicians, insurance payers, and medical manufacturers. The company states its mission is to deliver the highest quality equipment, supplies, and services cost-effectively while prioritizing patient rights, dignity, and confidentiality. about:
Total Packaging Company was founded in 1996 by Brian Schneider in Belmont, North Carolina. After a decade working for corrugated box manufacturers, Schneider left banking to create a one-stop shop for packaging and shipping materials. The business remains family-owned and operated, with a second location in Greenville, South Carolina.

The company provides a full range of packaging services including custom design, production, warehousing, inventory management, and distribution. It operates its own fleet of trucks for delivery across the country, and leverages global sourcing relationships to secure materials. Services also include packaging audits to identify cost savings and improve efficiency.

Total Packaging serves organizations of all sizes across a broad range of industries nationwide. Its model is built around acting as a single source for packaging needs, from initial design through to final delivery.

Schneider started the company to move beyond selling single-product lines and offer integrated solutions. The firm emphasizes personal service, quick response times, and the flexibility that comes from controlling its own logistics network, backed by over 70 years of combined industry experience among its team.

name: Total Plastics, Int’l
old_description: Total Plastics is your go-to plastics distributor in the Northeastern U.S., stocking acrylic / plexiglass sheets, Lexan® polycarbonate panels, engineered plastic rods, tubes, films and more.Beyond reliable plastics distribution, we offer precision value-added machining and custom fabrication services to meet your exact specifications.
about:
Total Plastics, Int'l was founded in 1978 by John Kozacki and Jerome Kollig in Kalamazoo, Michigan. The company began as a plastics warehouse and expanded to a national sales office in Grand Rapids, Michigan by 1984. Today it is headquartered in Renton, Washington, and operates a network of 15 locations across the United States.

The company stocks thousands of plastic sheets, rods, tubes, and films — including acrylic, polycarbonate, PEEK, PTFE, UHMW, and HDPE — and backs its inventory with precision CNC machining, laser cutting, waterjet cutting, thermoforming, and custom fabrication. Its services range from cut-to-size sheet fabrication and multi-axis CNC routing to turning, milling, welding, bonding, and full assembly. The firm says it handles everything from one-off prototypes to high-volume production runs, with tolerances as tight as ±0.005 inch.

Total Plastics serves aerospace, automotive, architecture and construction, medical and life sciences, marine, electronics and electrical, signage and graphics, and general manufacturing. Customers include aircraft interior manufacturers, medical device makers, boat builders, and retail display fabricators.

The company emphasizes its logistical reach — 15 U.S. locations with worldwide shipping — and its in-house material testing and dimensional inspection labs as differentiators. It also highlights rapid quoting, with most quotes returned within 24 hours.
